summary: Orion Digital Corp. filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, furnishing a press release dated September 28, 2026, announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company's shares maintained a closing bid price of at least US$1.00 for 14 consecutive business days from September 8 to September 25, 2026, exceeding the 10-day threshold. Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Staff confirmed the matter is now closed. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
